verdict.rationale: Dependent visas are a fair question for an immigration filing service, so the axis applies. The evidence pack covers principal petitions only (O-1, H-1B, TN, L-1, EB-1A, EB-2 NIW, plus fee calculation) and never mentions O-3, H-4, dependent filings for a spouse or children, or dependent work authorization. Absent any evidence for this applicable capability, the verdict is none.
